description: This Java utility class 'CsvUtils' provides methods for reading CSV data into Java objects using Jackson's CSV dataformat module. It initializes a CsvMapper with JavaTimeModule support and offers a static method to read CSV input streams into a list of specified types.

classes.name: CsvUtils
classes.description: A utility class for reading CSV data and converting it into Java objects. It uses Jackson's CsvMapper with JavaTimeModule support for parsing CSVs.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads CSV data from an InputStream into a list of objects of the specified class type.
